policy: All third-party sources are pinned by gitlinks. Do not update pins implicitly during calibration.

environment.note: HWComponents and HWComponents-CACTI at the pinned revisions require Python >=3.12. Use bootstrap.sh --core on Python 3.10/3.11 when energy modeling is not required.

modules.name: SCALE-Sim

nested.name: SCALE-Sim legacy Ramulator
nested.role: Internal dependency of the pinned SCALE-Sim v3 integration; distinct from the standalone Ramulator2 backend below

modules.role: Tensor-array compute, SRAM/DRAM traffic and SCALE-Sim v3 calibration

modules.name: Ramulator2
modules.role: Standalone modern cycle-level DDR/HBM controller and DRAM backend for the CModel

modules.name: BookSim2
modules.role: Cycle-accurate NoC contention for future multi-engine/multi-core simulation

modules.name: HWComponents
modules.role: Current Accelergy-Project hardware component modeling stack

modules.name: HWComponents-CACTI
modules.role: CACTI-backed SRAM/cache/DRAM area, latency and energy models

modules.name: Timeloop
modules.role: Optional mapping/tiling search and mapper cross-validation; default bootstrap does not build it because upstream requires system ISL/Barvinok
